race.comment: TOO DARN RIGHT (6) comes from a deep family, most notably a half brother to Shooting For Gold, who's a G3 winner and also trained by Matthew Hoysted. Two recent trials should have forward and the inside draw will give him a great look. Bold showing anticipated. OVERABUNDANT (5) is an Exceedance colt for the Dunn yard that has worked strongly in readiness, and Newman's 3kg claim gets him light. Big watch. DASHING HARRY (3) is a son of Harry Angel that has also come along nicely at the trials and benefits from a claim. Will pay to see what the market thinks. HOLY TERROR (4) was good on debut back in May but couldn't follow it up when sent to town. Looks to have come on well during the break and can make his presence felt.
